guide.rule: Days 1–100: 02 Nov 2026–09 Feb 2027. 10 Feb is a separate final review, outside the 100-day statistics.
Edit Daily mode, focus, output and planned minutes to match your actual availability. Changing the mode label alone does not change minutes.
Enter actual minutes per skill and academics, then set Day logged? to Yes. Blank actuals on a closed day count as zero. Unlogged days are excluded from adherence.
Actual skill minutes include video, exercises and projects. Count each minute once. Optional bus work can contribute, but missed bus work creates no backlog.
Default: 180 skill minutes on college days. Sunday: 240 skill minutes plus 120 academic minutes. These are planning assumptions, not measured capacity.
Wednesday/Thursday and your proposed Saturday early return add flexibility. No extra targets are automatically added; edit only after arrival is confirmed.
Reduce skill plan to 20–45 minutes, or 0 for rest. Keep a brief reflection if useful. Move one important task; do not stack all missed tasks onto tomorrow.
16–22 Nov: 60 skill minutes and 90 academic minutes/day proposed. 23–28 Nov: 0 required skill minutes and 180 academic minutes/day proposed. Adjust to exam timetable.
Exact dates unknown. 01–09 Feb is a provisional exam-flex period: 60 skill and 90 academic minutes/day. Replace these targets when dates are known.
Normal weeks reserve 120 minutes on Sunday, as requested. This is maintenance time, not a guarantee of exam readiness or an AI/data-science foundation.
MERN, n8n and Gen AI tools do not cover the whole AI/DS foundation. Use academic time for current maths/programming gaps; Python, statistics and ML need a later dedicated plan.
Source: your four course screenshots. MERN module sum is used. n8n headline and module sum agree. Gen AI headline is 19h38m but visible modules total 19h39m; module sum is used.
MERN uses 39 screenshot projects (earlier message said 36 tasks); n8n uses 10. DaVinci 14 is from your message. Gen AI screenshot shows 28. Project/task equivalence needs confirmation.
n8n and JavaScript/API practice come before agent projects. Begin with a read-only summary, then approval-based task planning, then one controlled workflow. Gen AI tools course is separate.

Keep actions narrow. Test normal input, missing data, wrong tool arguments and failures. Require approval for sending, deleting, spending or changing external records. Record limits and recovery steps.
A completed course is not mastery. Demonstrate a small build without copying, explain it, fix a defect and record evidence. Use Tasks to track this.
About 25–30 minutes/day: 10 speaking, 5 mindfulness, 2 morning vision, 2 evening vision, 3 gratitude/reflection; kindness and leadership are practised in daily interactions.
Satisfaction; making parents proud; financial freedom; a good reputation; building a successful startup. These are long-term directions, not promised 100-day outcomes.
Imagine the life you value, then write one action for today. Visualization/manifestation is used as reflection and intention-setting, not a guarantee of results.
Notice and name the feeling, pause, choose your response. Reflect on one difficult interaction without scoring your worth.
Record effort, learning and evidence of improvement. Doubt can occur; the aim is to act thoughtfully despite it.
Once per week take responsibility for a small outcome. Log an important decision, options, reason and later result in the weekly review.
Dashboard hours include all entered actuals. Adherence is the average capped daily achievement on closed days with a positive skill plan. Future/unlogged days are excluded.
10 Feb 2027: compare first and last speaking recordings, demonstrate projects, review hours and habits, identify weak areas and set the next 30-day focus.
Amber = editable inputs. White or pale neutral = calculated/output/reference cells. Avoid typing over formula cells.
This workbook has editable targets and formulas, not automatic rescheduling. Course task titles, exact semester exam dates, holidays and full roll number still need confirmation.
